sections.text:
-When Unison Chance is in effect, Unison Assist (increases total stats based on the number of members using the same effect) will activate.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Physical Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Concerto for 90 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 4. If Concerto is applied to allies as well, status ailments, debuffs, Cost reduction, and Unison gauge reduction will also be nullified based on the number of members (excluding self) in Concerto state).
Wind and Light Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 22000

Mirei Symphony or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
